fullDescription: A minimalist, high-contrast dark mode AI interface design system optimized for technical SaaS and developer tools. Featuring 'General Sans' typography, a deep black background (#0a0a0a), and refined border-driven layouts. The style utilizes a monochromatic palette with subtle gray-scale accents for information hierarchy, making it ideal for AI agents, terminal-style interfaces, and enterprise LLM dashboards. It emphasizes content focus through smooth cubic-bezier transitions and clean bento-inspired list items.

structured.summary: A sophisticated dark-mode conversational UI with a focus on technical clarity, featuring a monochromatic palette, rounded corner aesthetics (16px), and high-density information layout for AI agent feedback and history tracking.

style.description: The style is defined by a deep dark theme using #0a0a0a as the foundation. It relies on varying border shades (#222 to #444) for depth rather than shadows. Typography uses 'General Sans' for a modern, geometric look, paired with 'JetBrains Mono' for technical outputs. Micro-interactions utilize a consistent 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) transition for all hover states.
style.prompt: Create a design system with a base background of #0a0a0a and text in #e8e8e8. Use 'General Sans' as the primary font and 'JetBrains Mono' for technical details. Headings should be 12px uppercase with 0.2em tracking in #666. Primary UI borders should be 1px solid #222. Interactive elements like cards should transition to a #444 border on hover with a 0.3s cubic-bezier animation. Buttons should use high contrast: a primary white/near-white (#e8e8e8) background with dark text (#0a0a0a) for primary actions, and transparent backgrounds with #222 borders for secondary actions. Use a 16px (1rem) corner radius for containers and input fields.

layout_and_structure.description: A fixed header and footer layout with a flexible, scrollable main content area. The structure toggles between an 'empty state' dashboard view and an 'active chat' view.

prompts.prompt: Height: auto, with pt-14 px-6 pb-4. Border-bottom: 1px solid #222. Left side: 40x40px circular back button with a 20px icon centered. Right side: 32x32px circular avatar with a linear-gradient(to top right, #333, #555) and a 1px border (#444).

A vertical stack of 'Recent Conversations'. Includes a section title: 12px, uppercase, 0.2em tracking, color #666. Conversation cards: 16px corner radius, background #111 (for active/recent) or #0a0a0a, border #222, padding 16px. Card title: 14px font-medium. Card preview text: 13px, color #999, single line clamp.

Scrollable flex-1 area with 32px gap between message blocks. User messages: Right-aligned, max-width 85%, background #222, border #333, 16px padding, 16px radius with top-right corner set to 0. AI messages: Left-aligned, includes a sequence of execution steps in 13px #888 (e.g., '1. Initializing...'), followed by main response text in 15px #e8e8e8 with 1.625 line-height and list items with 8px spacing.

Fixed at bottom, pb-34px px-4. Contains a relative container for the text input. Input: background #111, border #222, 16px radius, height 56px, pl-20px pr-56px. Send button: Absolute positioned at right-8px, 40x40px, 12px radius, background #e8e8e8, color #0a0a0a. Icon: 20px centered.

special_ui_components.description: A sophisticated list item with subtle state changes.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a card with padding: 16px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #222; background: #0a0a0a. On hover, background transitions to #111 and border to #444. Inside, place a 14px medium weight title and a 13px light gray (#999) preview text truncated to one line.

special_ui_components.description: Subtle status indicators for AI processing steps.
special_ui_components.prompt: Use a vertical stack of text lines in 13px #888. Each line starts with a number (e.g., '1. ', '2. '). This block should appear before the main AI response to indicate background tasks, separated by 16px from the main message body.

structured.special_notes: Must-dos: Ensure all icons are consistent (Lucide/Iconify style). Maintain absolute black (#0a0a0a) for the body to ensure high contrast. Use 'General Sans' for the interface to maintain a 'premium tech' feel. Must-nots: Avoid using standard blue links; use white or high-contrast grays. Do not use standard drop shadows; define depth through border color increments.
